issues_found_and_fixed.issue: The Windows release bundle omitted contracts/v0.1 JSON schemas. The packaged NoneBot worker then failed to import its contracts module; the Koishi worker uses the same version-root schema directory.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: build-bundle.ps1 now validates and copies the contracts tree; install.ps1 validates the required schemas and copies them into each installed version.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: The previous installed NoneBot profile kept the FastAPI extra in the development group, so installation with --no-dev could not initialize the pinned FastAPI driver.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: The current locked production dependencies include nonebot2[fastapi]; the updated installation installed FastAPI 0.143.0 and imported the worker successfully.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: Updating an existing installation passed a null backup path to System.IO.File.Replace, which .NET rejected before activation.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: install.ps1 now uses a unique same-directory backup file while atomically replacing active.json, then removes the backup.

checks.detail: All three required v0.1 schemas were present in the built bundle and installed version.
The updated release bundle installed both profiles and activated the new version after replacing the prior active pointer.
Locked NoneBot dependencies installed with FastAPI 0.143.0; imports for FastAPI, NoneBot, OneBot v11, and the Ligamina worker passed.
run.ps1 prompted for profile selection and confirmation with APPDATA redirected into the isolated workspace, created configuration, and started Core.

Core listened on 127.0.0.1:26701; non-loopback listening was disabled; administrator/client tokens were 43 characters; operation grants were empty; database and host data were under the isolated user data root.
CLI reported ready=true; authenticated /v1/status returned koishi-default and nonebot-default active, restart_count=0, and last_error=null.
Authenticated POST /v1/shutdown returned HTTP 202; Core, Python, and Node process checks found no remaining packaged processes.
The isolated application version directory was removed while daemon.json and ligamina.sqlite remained under the separate user data root.
